title: Massive MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: New Airliner, Carrier & Bush Trips Checked Out!
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into a massive wave of new activities from Perfect Flight built to take your pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

Early community feedback is pouring in, with some highly rated five-star packages steering up some serious talk across the community. Whether you want to conquer high-stakes commercial airliner schedules, test your skills on a grueling carrier deck landing, or escape on an ultra-precise VFR sightseeing tour over iconic landmarks, these releases deliver a perfect excuse to jump back into the left seat. To help you choose if they are worth your hard-earned marketplace credits, we are breaking down everything included in these new additions:

First up, we are analyzing the high-stakes airline operations and precision challenges. This includes the "Air Canada Summer 2026" pack featuring 12 highly realistic IFR legs for the iniBuilds A320neo, packed with authentic sounds and over 100 distinct events. If you want a real test of reflexes, we also look at the new Advanced Carrier Landings pack designed for the Miltech Super Carrier Pro, putting you in the cockpit of the F/A-18 Super Hornet to tame the decks of the Nimitz, Ford, and Charles de Gaulle.

Next, group two throws you directly into the remote wilderness with the "Black Pearl Adventures" series. Inspired by an incredible real-world 4-year journey, these bush flying expeditions take you in the Kitfox SS7 across America’s West, the Pacific Northwest, and the Northern Rockies—making them perfect companions for immersive VR flying and exploring the newly updated World Update 22 scenery.

Finally, group three delivers premium VFR sightseeing with "Advanced VFR England." You will take the Bonanza G36 on a beautiful 12-mission sequential tour from the Scottish borders down to the Cornish coast at a crisp 3,500 feet.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up the complete Black Pearl Master Collection, or are you going to stick to the high-stakes airliner runs? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
